scope: One shared Cloudflare billing account serving ten CYBERDUDEBIVASH ECOSYSTEM platforms; account-wide rather than per-repo or per-run.
evidence_requirements: Read-only account-level Cloudflare billing/analytics snapshot with actual plan allowances, current used, forecast committed across all 10 platforms until each quota reset, projected candidate increment, full billing-product coverage assertion, and owner verification. Never hardcode assumed allowances.
notes: An offline release decision helper. It neither reads live Cloudflare metrics nor prevents unpredictable external request traffic. CI policy validation is not account usage certification; actual release authorization requires recent operator-verified account metrics.
